# Preserved upstream license files

These are unmodified license texts from the package versions in `inventory.json`.
Filenames identify the package and version; a `.txt` suffix is used even when
upstream named its file `LICENSE.md`. Copyright lines and the actual contents
are preserved. The ELK source header only normalizes trailing whitespace; the
cfworker third-party notice and all license texts retain their original bytes.
These notices retain upstream attribution that is not fully represented by npm
license metadata.

See `../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for artifact membership, provenance, source
links, and the limits of this inventory. These files license their respective
third-party components; they do not select a license for Paperstream itself.
